purpose: Controlled frozen-weight test of full legal bids in sealed auctions. No training or final qualification.
changed_behavior: Only sealed auction menus expand. Existing action feature75 is the same definition (best heuristic action), recomputed over the menu. Full references are separately named; old identities/weights/menus stay unchanged.

evaluation.primary_contrast: Expanded minus control per opponent/count, overall and each rule. Exact open-game identity is a required isolation check. Report all cells and regressions.
evaluation.inference: Marginal exploratory whole-deal intervals, not adjusted for multiple comparisons. Same weights, no training seed variance estimate. New full-menu opponents are not presumed stronger and do not replace existing baselines.

requirements: Strict single-request parity and legal serving on all2553 identical requests with separate engine-legal lists.
Every game complete; exact paired deal/seat/rule coverage and explicit search-cap accounting.
Exact original encoder and actor menus; no global candidate overrides in actual games.
Original and expanded inference tensors identical; source/model/fixture hashes immutable.
All open game terminal states, step and action-type counts identical per condition/reference.
No final reserved seeds, optimizer steps, production publication or qualification.
known_limitations: Existing search proposal indices refer to pruned menus. Expanded-menu search is explicitly rejected, not silently remapped. This experiment uses raw policy only.
Existing serving fixture legal lists remain untouched; separate all-engine-legal lists include3002 additional sealed bids whose engine application was checked.
Potential bid-precision gains must survive references with full sealed menus; winning against pruned opponents alone is insufficient.

execution.reason: Both unchanged-weight policies run on the same CPU host to avoid host-dependent numeric differences in the required open-game identity check.
